issues.description: The template declares the program entry symbol as 'global main' but the solution file declares 'global _start' while still defining a 'main:' label. This inconsistency in the global entry identifier can confuse students about which symbol is expected as the program entry point and may cause linking/runtime issues or make it unclear which label to implement/modify.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the entry symbol consistent across template and solution. Either change the solution's 'global _start' to 'global main' (so the defined 'main:' label is exported), or if the intent is to use '_start' then rename the label 'main:' to '_start' and ensure the build/link settings match that choice. Prefer keeping 'global main' to match the template and typical gcc linking.
